The fifth season of the ''[[Bleach (TV series)|Bleach]]'' [[anime]] series is named the {{nihongo|'''Bount Assault on Soul Society arc'''|バウント・尸魂界強襲篇|Baunto Sōru Sosaeti Kyōshū Hen}}. In the English adaptation of the anime released by [[Viz Media]], the title of the season is translated as '''The Assault'''.<ref name="amazonseason5">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.com/exec/obidos/ASIN/B002NXSTGY|title=Amazon.com: Bleach, Vol. 23: Bleach: Movies & TV|publisher=[[Amazon.com]]|access-date=April 4, 2010}}</ref> The episodes are directed by [[Noriyuki Abe]], and produced by [[TV Tokyo]], [[Dentsu]], and [[Studio Pierrot]].<ref name="staff">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://pierrot.jp/title/bleach/staff.html|title=ぴえろ BLEACH =ブリーチ=|publisher=[[Studio Pierrot]]|language=ja|access-date=April 4, 2009}}</ref> Like the previous season, it does not adapt from [[Tite Kubo]]'s [[manga]] series of the [[Bleach (manga)|same name]]. Instead, it features an original, self-contained [[Filler (media)|filler]] story arc focusing on the invasion of the [[Bleach (manga)#Setting|Soul Society]], the home of the [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach|Soul Reapers]], by the Bount, a race of vampiric beings that consume human souls to gain power.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/review/bleach-season-4-box-set-2/the-bount |title=Bleach Season 4 Box Set 2: The Bount|date=September 7, 2010|author=Martin, Theron|website=[[Anime News Network]]|access-date=April 14, 2011}}</ref>

The season aired from August 2006 to January 2007, on [[TV Tokyo]]. It lasted eighteen episodes. The English adaptation of the season aired on [[Cartoon Network]]'s [[Adult Swim]] in the United States from December 2008 to April 2009.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2008-01-28/adult-swim-to-run-52-more-episodes-of-bleach|title=Adult Swim to Run 52 More Episodes of Bleach|website=[[Anime News Network]]|date=2008-01-28|access-date=April 12, 2009}}</ref><ref name="air">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B003QUUORK/|title=Bleach (English Dubbed) Season 5, Ep. 1 "Bleach 92"|publisher=[[Amazon.com]]|access-date=April 15, 2011}}</ref> Four DVD compilations of the season were released by [[Aniplex]] between January 24 and April 25, 2007.<ref name="AmazonJPDVD1">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B000L22PF0|title=BLEACH バウント・尸魂界強襲篇1|language=ja|access-date=September 25, 2008}}</ref><ref name="AmazonJPDVD4">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B000NVIKX0|title=BLEACH バウント 尸魂界・強襲篇 4|language=ja|access-date=September 25, 2008}}</ref> The first two DVD compilations contain four episodes of the season, and the last two contain five episodes.<ref name="StudioPierrotDVDs">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://pierrot.jp/title/bleach/goods/dvd/dvd05/|title=BLEACH 尸魂界・強襲篇|publisher=[[Studio Pierrot]]|language=ja|access-date=September 25, 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090318030442/http://pierrot.jp/title/bleach/goods/dvd/dvd05/|archive-date=March 18, 2009 }}</ref> [[Viz Media]] released this season in four DVD volumes from December 15, 2009, to March 23, 2010.<ref name="VizDVD23">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=8596 |title=Bleach, Vol. 23 (DVD) |publisher=[[Viz Media]] |access-date=August 28, 2009 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090812032844/http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=8596 |archive-date=August 12, 2009 }}</ref><ref name="VizDVD26">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=8399 |title=Bleach, Vol. 26 (DVD) |publisher=[[Viz Media]] |access-date=August 28, 2009 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160413190414/http://www.viz.com/watch/dvd-box-set/naruto-shippuden-uncut-video-box-sets-volume-3/8399 |archive-date=April 13, 2016 }}</ref> A DVD box set of the season was released on June 8, 2010.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.viz.com/products/products.php?product_id=8626/ |title=Bleach Uncut Box Set: Season 5 - The Assault |publisher=[[Viz Media]] |access-date=2011-04-15 }}{{dead link|date=June 2017 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> [[Manga Entertainment]] released the season in two DVDs for the United Kingdom on August 30 and November 1, 2010,<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B003TG5P8E/|title=Bleach - Series 5 Part 1|website=Amazon UK |access-date=2011-04-15}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B003VOIPHC/|title=Bleach - Series 5 Part 2|website=Amazon UK |access-date=April 15, 2011}}</ref> while a box set was released on December 20, 2010.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B003VRRW7I/|title=Bleach Series 5 Complete Box Set|website=Amazon UK |access-date=April 15, 2011}}</ref>

The episodes use four pieces of [[theme music]]: two opening themes and two ending themes. The opening theme for the first six episodes is "Tonight, Tonight, Tonight" by [[Beat Crusaders]];<ref name="music1">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|title=BLEACH～ブリーチ|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|access-date=April 8, 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060821195513/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|archive-date=2006-08-21|language=ja}}</ref> the rest of the episodes use "[[Rolling Star]]" by [[Yui (singer)|Yui]].<ref name="music2">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|title=BLEACH～ブリーチ|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|access-date=April 8, 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070103065619/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/bleach/staff.html|archive-date=January 3, 2007|language=ja}}</ref> The ending themes are Takacha's "Movin!!", used for the first six episodes,<ref name="music1" /> and "Baby It's You" by [[June (singer)|June]], used for the remainder of the episodes.<ref name="music2" /> The opening and ending themes for episodes 106 to 109 use footage from the ''Bleach'' feature film, ''[[Bleach: Memories of Nobody]]'', to promote the film, which was released on December 16, 2006.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/bleach/first/info2.html|title=劇場版BLEACH -インフォメーション 最新情報|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=April 13, 2009}}</ref>

| EpisodeNumber   = 92

| Title           = Invasion of the Shinigami World, Again

| AltDate         = December 14, 2008
| ShortSummary    = First division captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto|Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto]] calls for a meeting of all the Soul Reaper [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#captain|captains]] to discuss the Bount threat. Captain [[Tōshirō Hitsugaya]] is tasked with defeating the Bounts, and Yamamoto gives a standing order to kill all suspected intruders without hesitation. In the Rukongai, the area outside the Soul Reaper fortress of Seireitei, the Bounts [[List of Bleach characters#Jin Kariya|Jin Kariya]] and [[List of Bleach characters#Gō Koga|Gō Koga]] defeat the Soul Reapers sent to capture them. Meanwhile, [[Ichigo Kurosaki]] and his friends enter the Soul Society, and [[Yoruichi Shihōin]] explains that [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Maki Ichinose|Maki Ichinose]], a Soul Reaper under Kariya's command, manipulated captain [[Mayuri Kurotsuchi]] into opening the gate into the Soul Society.
| LineColor       = F66D58
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist

| EpisodeNumber   = 93
| EpisodeNumber2  = 2
| Title           = The Bount Assault! The Gotei 13 of Destructive Earthquake

| AltDate         = December 21, 2008
| ShortSummary    = Ichigo and his friends begin to search different parts of the Rukongaki for the Bounts. While searching, [[Rukia Kuchiki]] is attacked by the Bount [[List of Bleach characters#Yoshi|Yoshi]]. Caught without her ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#zanpakutō|zanpakutō]]'', Rukia is quickly overpowered by Yoshi. Meanwhile, Yamamoto is explaining the origins of the Bounts to the assembled captains, and a messenger informs him that Rukia is fighting a Bount. As Rukia is about to receive a fatal blow from Yoshi, captain [[Byakuya Kuchiki]] arrives and attacks her. Following the fight, several buildings in the Seireitei explode.
| LineColor       = F66D58
}}

In the Rukongai, Kariya enters Kusajishi, one of the most crime-ridden parts of ''Rukongai'', and asks the populace to aid him in fighting the Soul Reapers. Ichigo, [[Uryū Ishida]], and [[Yasutora Sado|Yasutora "Chad" Sado]] begin searching for the Bounts again, and Ichigo takes the [[List of Bleach characters#Modified souls|modified soul]] [[List of Bleach characters#Lirin|Lirin]] with him. Elsewhere in a forest in the Rukongai, Byakuya encounters Kariya.

| 1               = Bleach season 5
| EpisodeNumber   = 95

| Title           = Byakuya Takes the Field! Dance of the Wind-Splitting Cherry Blossoms
| TranslitTitle   = Byakuya Shutsujin! Kaze o Saku Sakura no Mai
| NativeTitle     = 白哉出陣！風を裂く桜の舞

| AltDate         = January 4, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Byakuya and Kariya begin their battle, and Kariya reveals his doll Messer, which gives him the ability to control wind. Byakuya uses his ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#shikai|shikai]]'', but Kariya uses a barrier of wind to deflect his attack. Ichigo arrives to assist Byakuya, and after using his ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#bankai|bankai]]'', begins to fight Kariya. With Kariya focused on fighting Ichigo, Byakuya uses his ''bankai'', and manages to penetrate Kariya's wind barrier. However, Kariya heals himself, revealing that in the Soul Society, the Bounts can consume the spirit particles in the air to restore their bodies. In Kusajishi, Koga and Ichinose convince the inhabitants to join them in their revolt in order to create a "new Soul Society".
| LineColor       = F66D58

In a forest in the Rukongai, Hitsugaya confronts Ichinose, and begins to fight him as [[Renji Abarai]], [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Rangiku Matsumoto|Rangiku Matsumoto]], Ichigo, and Chad arrive. In Kusajishi, Kariya prepares to invade the Seireitei.

{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 5
| EpisodeNumber   = 98
| EpisodeNumber2  = 7
| Title           = Clash! Kenpachi Zaraki vs. Maki Ichinose
| TranslitTitle   = Gekitotsu! Zaraki Kenpachi VS Ichinose Maki
| NativeTitle     = 激突！更木剣八VS一之瀬真樹
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = [[Yuji Moriyama|Norihiro Sunagawa]]
| DirectedBy      = Hodaka Kuramoto
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2006|10|4}}
| AltDate         = January 25, 2009
| ShortSummary    = Hitsugaya and Ichinose continue their battle, and Ichinose uses his ''shikai'', blinding all of those present. As Ichinose is about to attack Chad, his attack is blocked by eleventh division captain [[Kenpachi Zaraki]]. Kenpachi instructs Hitsugaya to take the group and stop Kariya from invading ''Sereitei'', and Ichinose, torn between his loyalty to Kariya and desire to avenge his former captain by killing Kenpachi, decides to stay and fight Kenpachi. Kenpachi easily blocks all of Ichinose's attacks, forcing him to use his ''zanpakutō'' to trap him in a sphere of light. Kenpachi removes his eyepatch and releases his full power to destroy the sphere. Refusing to surrender, Ichinose attacks Kenpachi a final time, and Kenpachi slices him across the chest, leaving him for dead.
| LineColor       = F66D58
}}

As they enter, Kariya kills the Kusajishi inhabitants, claiming that their usefulness has ended. Kariya dispatches the Bounts to eliminate the Soul Reaper captains, and heads farther into ''Sereitei''. Second division captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Suì-Fēng|Suì-Fēng]] orders her men to attack the Bounts, but the Bount [[List of Bleach characters#Mabashi|Mabashi]] uses his doll Ritz to take control of them. When Suì-Fēng asks for a status report, one of her men controlled by Ritz attacks her with a ''bitto''.
| LineColor       = F66D58

| AltDate         = February 8, 2009
| ShortSummary    = The ''bitto'' incapacitates Suì-Fēng with a poison, and Ritz uses the controlled Soul Reapers to cause chaos throughout ''Sereitei'' by turning them against other Soul Reapers, including seventh division captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Sajin Komamura|Sajin Komamura]] and ninth division lieutenant [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Shūhei Hisagi|Shūhei Hisagi]], who manage to knock many of the infected Soul Reapers unconscious. Meanwhile, Suì-Fēng attempts to fight Mabashi, and hits him once with her ''shikai'', leaving a mark on his chest. She collapses from the poison, and Mabashi attempts to use Ritz to control her. Suì-Fēng then quickly strikes Mabashi in the chest to deal a fatal blow, revealing that her ''zanpakutō'' allows her to counteract poisons. Elsewhere, Mayuri confronts the Bount [[List of Bleach characters#Sawatari|Sawatari]].
| LineColor       = F66D58
}}
{{#invoke:Episode list|sublist

| ShortSummary    = Sawatari attacks Mayuri with his doll Baura, and manages to rip Mayuri's left arm off. Mayuri regenerates his arm with his medicine, and uses his ''zanpakutō'' to paralyze Baura. Mayuri then stabs Sawatari in the right arm, and Baura manages to overcome the paralysis to retreat with Sawatari into another dimension. Sawatari surfaces in another location in ''Sereitei'', and Mayuri appears, revealing that he made a scanner to track the Bount. Sawatari attacks Mayuri with the power of other Soul Reapers that Baura absorbed in previous battles. Mayuri is forced to use his ''bankai'', and kills Sawatari. Elsewhere, Uryū begins to fight the Bount Yoshi.
| LineColor       = F66D58
}}

Despite the efforts of Chad and Ichigo, Kariya finds the Jōkaishō, and after fusing with it, claims he has enough power to destroy ''Sereitei''.

Koga summons his doll Dalk, who is quickly frozen and shattered by the ''shikai'' of Hitsugaya's ''zanpakutō''. Koga fuses the remains of Dalk into an axe, and Hitsugaya uses his ''bankai'' in response. | ShortSummary    = Kariya recalls the events after the Soul Reapers' attack on the Bounts. After escaping from the Soul Reapers, he fused with his doll when attacked by a hollow. Desiring to travel to the Soul Society to make peace with their creators, the Bounts attempted to use the Quincy to enter the Soul Society, and were defeated. Kariya organized the remaining Bounts in order to take revenge on the Soul Society. In the present, Uryū arrives and fights Kariya. Rantao uses the Jōkaishō's power to stun Kariya, and asks Uryū to kill Kariya. However, Rantao begins to feel pain from the Jōkaishō, and Uryū uses his remaining power to save her, which destroys his Quincy battle accessory. As Kariya is about to kill Uryū and Rantao, Ichigo arrives.
| LineColor       = F66D58

| ShortSummary    = Ichigo uses his ''bankai'' and begins to fight Kariya. Rantao reveals that there are multiple Jōkaishō scattered throughout the Soul Society that will detonate when Kariya uses his Jōkaishō, and the Soul Reapers of the [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Gotei Thirteen|Thirteen Court Guard Squads]] begin to seal all of the Jōkaishō. Meanwhile, Ichinose arrives and attacks Ichigo, but turns his sword on Kariya, claiming that he did not join Kariya to watch him destroy the Soul Society. Kariya kills Ichinose, and reveals Messer in the form of a sword of wind.

| ShortSummary    = Kariya uses the wind Messer to produce electricity, and attacks Ichigo with it. Ichigo's [[List of Bleach characters#Hollow Ichigo|inner hollow]] momentarily takes over his body, but Ichigo regains control of his body, surprising Kariya. Ichigo informs Kariya that he cannot absorb spirit particles to heal himself because Rantao sealed his absorption ability. Ichigo and Kariya engage in a final clash where Kariya is killed. Ichigo concludes that Kariya intended to travel to the Soul Society in order to end his eternal life.

| ShortSummary    = Ichigo, Renji and Rukia return to the Kuchiki house to discuss Kariya's life. Ichigo remarks on how his life was changed when Rukia gave him her powers, Renji recalls when he was promoted to lieutenant of the sixth division, and Rukia reminisces on the day when she was assigned to the real world. Afterwards, Ichigo and his friends return to the real world. Yoruichi brings Koga, who survived his fight with Hitsugaya, to Rantao's hideout. Hidden from the Soul Reapers, he is able to recover from his injuries. Koga accepts that the destiny of the Bounts is to eventually die out. On the last scene, Ichigo and friends are seen heading to the real world, then a mysterious person is seen entering Karakura Town.
